lib.empty.title: Nocht funn
lib.empty.text: Gie anither name a go or turn on “Shaw gemms athoot exe”.
fav.title: Favourits
fav.empty.title: Nocht heer yet
fav.empty.text: Dunt the starn on a gemm trunsher tae eik it heer.
detail.finding: Luikin for an instawed copy o the gemm…
detail.notInstalled: Nae instawed copy funn, an that’s braw: the decoy disna need ane.
detail.noteDone: Ye can haud it nou, the quest shoud be coontit.
detail.noteRunning: The process rins in the backgroond. Ye can nip the windae tae the tray.
detail.noExe.title: Discord disna ken this gemm’s exe yet
detail.noExe.text: It canna be funn bi process. Dunt “Eik database” later: ance Discord eiks an exe, the gemm comes available.
running.title: Rinnin
running.empty.title: Nocht is rinnin
running.empty.text: Apen a gemm in the leebrar an dunt “Stairt decoy”.
settings.title: Settins
settings.language.desc: Interface leid. New leids are eikit as files in the locales fauder.
settings.defaultTime.desc: Hou mony meenits tae keep the process. The stannin duration is 16, no 15: Discord quests speir for 15 meenits o play, but Discord needs up tae a meenit tae notice a new gemm, sae exackly 15 faws short.
settings.smartTimer.desc: The coontdoun stairts whan Discord has noticed the decoy, no whan ye stairt it. Tae ken that, the app reads anerly the lines anent the rinnin gemm frae Discord's local log; nocht is stored or sent oniewhaur.
settings.autoUpdate.desc: Check GitHub at stairtup an ilka 6 oors an dounlaid new versions in the backgrund. Installin aye bides for yer confirm, an files are checkit bi their deegital seegnatur.
update.uptodate: Ye ar on the newest version
detail.waitingNote: Discord needs up tae a meenit tae notice a gemm. The coontdoun stairts whan it sees the decoy.
detail.assumed: Discord hasna confirmed it, the time is coontit oniewey.
settings.autoStop.desc: The decoy ends bi itsel whan the time is up.
settings.notify.desc: A Windows notification whan the time is up.
settings.tray: Nip doun tae tray on steek
settings.tray.desc: Decoys keep rinnin whiles the app is in the tray.
settings.showNoExe.desc: Entries whaur Discord disna ken the process yet (they canna be stairtit).
settings.dataDir.desc: Whaur the gemm leet an settins are keepit.
settings.dataDir.portable: Portable mode: awthing is keepit neist tae decoy.exe.
settings.legal: Decoy disna uise yer Discord token an disna takk on quests for ye. Fakin a gemm process micht gang agane Discord’s rules, uise it at yer ain risk.
toast.launched: “{name}” stairtit for {n} min. Discord shoud notice it in aboot 15 seconds.
toast.timeUp: Time is up, the quest shoud be coontit
toast.refreshUpToDate: The database is awready up tae date
lab.title: Lab
lab.subtitle: A derne tab: stairts monie decoys at aince.
lab.count.desc: Gemms are waled at random, anes awready rinnin are skippit. Ilka ane rins for {n} min (set in Settins).
lab.warn: Ilka decoy is a sindry process wi a windae. Ower mony at ance can freeze yer computer: ilka process an windae uises mynd, an efter a puckle thoosand windaes Windows micht stop makin mair. Gin ye steek Decoy, aw decoys haud.
lab.risk.mid: Frae aboot 250 decoys on, Discord itsel micht gang slow: it bides track o ilka rinnin gemm an reports it tae its servers.
lab.risk.high: Denger: whan 5,000 decoys war stairtit at ance, Discord grew past 10 GB o RAM an crasht ilka 30 seiconts till its local data wis reset. Decoy hauds awthing gin Discord’s memory loups up, but there is nae guarantee.
lab.discordRam: Discord is uisin {gb} GB o RAM richt nou.
lab.unlock.desc: Aboon this leemit Discord haes broken in practice. Turn it on anerly gin ye ken the risk.
guard.tripped: Aw decoys stoppit tae bield Discord: it is uisin {gb} GB o RAM (up {grew} GB). Gin it is slow, restairt it.
lab.next: Gemms gang in alphabetical order. The neist batch stairts wi “{name}”.
lab.estimate: {n} decoys will uise rochly {ram} o RAM.
lab.limit: Windows stoppit stairtin new processes efter {n}: that is the seestem leemit.
notify.title: Time is up
